name: task-github
description: GitHub delivery adapter for work that needs Issue Tree projection, PR and CI transport, review handoff, merge, and gated closeout; not for local-only execution.

interface.shortDescription: Project work graphs into GitHub delivery workflows.
interface.longDescription: Use when a provider-neutral work graph needs durable GitHub Issue tracking or PR, CI, review, merge, and closeout transport. It projects complete graphs to GitHub Issue trees and owns the GitHub lifecycle while keeping external review ownership opaque. Local-only execution should use its underlying work path without this delivery adapter.
defaultPrompt: Use $init to create or validate local task-github provider configuration without GitHub mutation.
Use $define to project a task-worker definition into a linked GitHub Issue tree.
Use $orchestrate only for worker dispatch; manual dispatch must never create local worker runs.
